description: Fly Fishing teaches the craft of fishing with flies: safety, a balanced rod, line and leader, knots, the kinds of flies and tying your own, casting, reading what fish eat, catch and release, regulations and sportsmanship, and catching and cooking a fish.

safety.note: Wear eye protection while casting and a life jacket on boats; know how to remove a hook safely.

versions.label: Checked against official scouting.org excerpts (partial verification)

provenance.notes: Requirement numbering and topics were checked against excerpts of official Scouting America pages (scouting.org) returned by a search index on 2026-10-24. The pages themselves could not be opened from the build environment, so wording was not compared word for word and some sub-items may be summarized from partial excerpts. Summaries are ScoutPath's own words.

references.label: Official merit badge page (scouting.org Merit Badge Hub)

requirements.title: Health and safety
requirements.summary: Likely hazards, safety practices, and preventing and treating common problems such as cuts, hypothermia and sunburn.

children.title: Catching a fish
children.summary: Catching a fish on a fly and identifying it.

children.title: Cleaning and cooking
children.summary: Where regulations allow, cleaning and cooking a fish.

requirements.title: A balanced system
requirements.summary: Matching rod, line and leader, types of fly line, and caring for your gear.

requirements.title: Knots
requirements.summary: The knots that join backing, line, leader, tippet and fly.

requirements.title: Flies
requirements.summary: The main kinds of flies, what they imitate, and tying flies of your own.

requirements.title: Casting
requirements.summary: Overhead and roll casts at a set distance.

requirements.title: Observing fish
requirements.summary: What fish eat above and below the surface, and matching the hatch.

requirements.title: Catch and release
requirements.summary: What catch and release means and how to release a fish safely.

requirements.title: Regulations
requirements.summary: Local fishing regulations and why they exist.

requirements.title: Sportsmanship
requirements.summary: Outdoor ethics for anglers, including Leave No Trace and the Outdoor Code.
